messages:
eli: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem 
We need owners for: (1) panic button, (2) automated rollback, (3) rollout telemetry. Short deadlines pls.
maya: I can own telemetry and dashboards. Will emit 'rollout_pct' and 'flag_error_rate' with 30d retention. ETA: 6 days.
raj: I'll take automated rollback. Proposal: require 2 signals (error rate AND p95 latency) sustained for 3m before auto-rollback. Will draft config + tests. ETA: 10 days.
ops-bot: incident-bot: postmortem #998 created -> link: https://redwood/postmortems/998. Please add follow-ups.
eli: Ops will own panic button + runbook. Want an HTTP endpoint + Console action that sets flag to 0% and notifies #incidents. Prototype by end of sprint.
maya: Also adding a dashboard tile with alert levels: warn at 50% of threshold, critical at threshold; route to #eng-oncall + PagerDuty.
raj: Plan for runtime: read flag metadata (max_pct, safety_window, cb thresholds) and enforce caps. Will include CI simulation that fakes spike and verifies rollback triggers.
eli: Action list added to postmortem tracker: telemetry (maya) 6d, auto-rollback (raj) 10d, panic endpoint/runbook (ops) 12d. Quarterly review for recurring patterns. Ping me if blocked.
ops-bot: reminder: attach PRs and tracker updates to the postmortem record.
